text:
Anna: Quick heads-up — planned cutover tonight 23:00 UTC to roll runtime -> v2.4.0 (canary first). Need API / runtime / console / router checks + pinned variants ready. Release notes: https://intra.redwood/release/2.4.0 :eyes:
Liam: Ack. I'll take API pin + canary slice. Plan: pin api service -> v1.13.0 for 5% traffic at 23:00, then 25/50/100 if green. ETA pin at 22:50 UTC.
Jordana: Console smoke plan: run auth/login, route-list, editor open, eval-run (small prompt) at 22:30 staging -> 22:55 prod smoke. Will post failures.
Kevin: Router update: staged routing-config applied in staging. Prod cutover will update header-split + weighted routes. If we see >0.5% 5xx in 5m, we abort and roll back routing change.
Emma: Ops checklist added to the release notes: rollback criteria: 1) sustained 5xx >1% across all regions for 10m OR 2) p95 latency increase >200ms baseline for 5m OR 3) critical auth failures. Alerting runbook linked.
Anna: TL;DR rollback signal: call it in this thread + ping @oncall + /deploy rollback <service> <version>. Keep messages short.
Liam: Quick confirm — will we need a console feature-flag flip?
Jordana: Yes — console feature flag 'new-runtime-support' will be enabled for canary only. I'll flip after API pin and revert if any errors.
Emma: Ops will watch SLOs. Added temporary SLI dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/xXy/runtime-cutover
Kevin: Router will mirror canary weights from API. If API canary is 5% then router route will send 5% to runtime-canary pool.
Anna: Can someone run the preflight command once pins are set? Example:
```
# pin runtime for canary
/deploy pin --service runtime --version v2.4.0 --wave canary --note "2.4.0 canary for cross-service cutover"
```
Liam: Running pin now in staging.
deploy-bot: executed: /deploy pin --service api --version v1.13.0 --wave canary by Liam at 2024-05-16T22:50:12Z — status: OK, pinned to canary slice 5%.
Jordana: Console flag flipped in staging, running smoke: auth ok, list ok, eval-run 0.8s.
Emma: Ops check: no elevated 5xx in staging. P95 latency +8ms.
Kevin: Router staged mirror applied.
Anna: Awesome. We'll start prod pin at 23:00 UTC. Rollback triggers repeated here so folks don't have to dig. If anyone sees anything, post here and @oncall.
Liam: Noted. I'll monitor API error budget and post per-wave status.
Jordana: I'll attach any console errors here.
Kevin: If we hit rollback, router will be reverted via: `/deploy pin --service router --version v<prev> --wave full` and weight rollback to 100% old.
Emma: Ops will run evasive traffic tests post-canary to validate routing hedges.
deploy-bot: scheduled: canary rollout for runtime v2.4.0 at 2024-05-16T23:00:00Z. Healthcheck window: 5m after each weight increase. Auto-rollback disabled (manual only) per request.
Anna: final note — release notes link above includes changelog and rollback runbook. Thx everyone :rocket:
ops-bot: reminder scheduled at 22:55 UTC to @eng-release for final go/no-go ping.
